refused_program.intent: Resolve a diverged upstream sync conflict by starting from upstream's version of each conflicted file, re-adding the local additions, and committing the merge.

postconditions.description: no merge is left in progress
postconditions.name: merge_completed

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit whose history contains the upstream branch
postconditions.name: merge_commit_has_two_parents
postconditions.probe:
[ "$(git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD | wc -w)" -eq 3 ] && \
git merge-base --is-ancestor {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} HEAD

postconditions.description: the index has no unmerged entries after the resolution
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: the working tree is clean after committing the resolution
postconditions.name: worktree_clean

postconditions.description: the committed resolution contains no conflict-marker lines
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers_in_merge_diff

preconditions.description: the upstream tracking ref named by the parameters resolves to a commit
preconditions.name: upstream_ref_exists

preconditions.description: the current branch is both ahead of and behind the upstream branch
preconditions.name: diverged_from_upstream

preconditions.description: at least one path changed on both sides exists in the merge base and on both branch tips
preconditions.name: content_conflict_candidate
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) && \
found=0 && \
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -n "$p" ] && git cat-file -e "$base:$p" 2>/dev/null && \
     git cat-file -e "HEAD:$p" 2>/dev/null && \
     git cat-file -e "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$p" 2>/dev/null; then
    found=1
    break
  fi
done < <(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort)) && \
[ "$found" -eq 1 ]

preconditions.description: the worktree is clean, or a conflicted merge of the upstream branch is already in progress
preconditions.name: clean_or_upstream_conflicted_merge
preconditions.probe:
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  [ "$(git rev-parse MERGE_HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})" ] && \
  [ -n "$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)" ]
else
  [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]
fi
